requirements.text:
The sample class is the FiniteAutomaton class the following attributes
- alphabet as String

The fragment is composed of the Automatoon class with the following attributes:
- letter as String.

The fragment is composed of the State class with the following attributes:
- name as String

The fragment is composed of the FiniteAutomaton and Transition class.
FiniteAutomaton has no attributes and an association to the Transition class named transitionSet with a multiplicity of 0 or more.
Transition has no attributes.

The fragment is composed of the FiniteAutomaton class and the State class.
FiniteAutomaton has no attributes and a relation to State named finalStateSet with a multiplicity of one or more.
State has no attributes.

The fragment is composed of the Automatoon class and the State class. Automatoon has no attributes and an association to State named source with a multiplicity of 1.
State has no attributes.
The fragment is composed of the State class with an association to from State to State named combination with a multiplicity of 1.
